plugin.name: FileGator File Manager
plugin.description: Enhanced multi-user FileGator file manager for one site. Installs a pinned FileGator release under the site plugins folder, jails the repository to that site home, and publishes a clean /filegator URL. Free.
plugin.author: master3395

features.feature: Pinned FileGator 7.16.5 download with SHA256 verify
Site-jailed repository root (site home by default)
Clean public URL /filegator under the site docroot
Update-safe heal preserves private data and credentials

plugin.uninstall_impact: Site /filegator URL and FileGator app under the site plugins folder are removed
Admin credentials under /var/lib/cpn/filegator/<domain>/ remain until cleaned manually
